name: Frame Sense Trainer
detailed_description:
🟦 Frame Sense Trainer

Build Your Temporal Frame Estimation Skill at 60 FPS

Frame Sense Trainer is a focused training application designed to help animators, game developers, motion designers, and pro FGC or other Esports athletes develop a precise internal sense of timing, measured in frames at 60 frames per second.

The program guides users through structured tutorials, exercises, and quizzes that train their ability to estimate the duration of animations in discrete frame counts—a skill I like to call Temporal Frame Estimation.

🎯 Core Features

  • Step-by-Step Tutorials
    Learn the foundational concepts behind frame-based timing and how to perceive time intervals at 60 FPS.

  • Targeted Exercises
    Practice estimating how many frames an animation lasts, and build your intuition through repetition and correction.

  • Challenging Quizzes
    Test your accuracy in frame estimation under timed conditions and track your progress over time.

🧠 Why Temporal Frame Estimation?

In animation, motion design, and game development, the ability to think in frames is critical for precise timing and polish. Frame Sense Trainer helps you internalize this temporal measurement, making it easier to:

  • Estimate and adjust animation timing with greater precision

  • Communicate clearly in frame-based terms

  • Improve feel and responsiveness in interactive media

👤 Who Is It For?

  • Game developers

  • Competitive fighting game players and Esports athletes looking to sharpen frame-accurate timing

  • Motion designers

  • Animators
